label: HUMAN AUTHORIZATION
heading: Your approval stays separate
intro: This dedicated page will confirm the exact administrative action before you authorize it with a passkey.
disabledDetail: The executor is still being prepared. Registering a passkey does not enable or run any command.
setupMissing: Open the single-use invitation created from the administrator terminal to register this device.
setupReady: This invitation was created from the administrator terminal. Register a passkey using Face ID, Touch ID or your authenticator. The administrator must then finish verification in the terminal.
waiting: Follow the instructions on your device…
staged: Response received. Finish verification in the administrator terminal. Commands remain disabled.
cancelled: Registration was cancelled or timed out. You can try again while the invitation is valid.
unavailable: The invitation is expired, already used or unavailable. Create a new one from the administrator terminal.
unsupported: Passkey registration is unavailable in this browser. Open this HTTPS page in Safari on your device.
network: Unable to confirm the result. Check the connection and ask the administrator to check the invitation before trying again.
footer: No sudo password is requested or sent. Authorization requires a verified passkey; isolation also depends on keeping administrator credentials outside agent control.
outcome_unknown: Outcome to be checked: an administrator must reconcile it from the terminal. No automatic retry.
operationChanged: The operation changed. Reload this page and review it before authorizing.
commandUnavailable: Administrative confirmation is unavailable or disabled. No new authorization was confirmed.
commandCancelled: Confirmation was cancelled or timed out. No new authorization was confirmed.
commandNetwork: The result could not be confirmed. This page checks its saved status; do not create another proposal.
commandUnsupported: Passkey confirmation is unavailable. Open this HTTPS page in Safari.
bridgeEvidence: Outcome reported by the desktop user service; this is not an independent health check.
restart-backendDescription: Restart the Placet backend. The PWA will disconnect briefly and recover its saved state.
restart-bridgeDescription: Restart the bridge in the configured desktop user session. Message delivery will pause briefly.
expired: Proposal expired. Create another from the PWA.
returnToApp: Return to the Placet app. Switch back manually; the status refreshes when you return.
noDiagnostic: No detailed diagnostic is available for this result.
result_helper_spawn_failed: The bridge helper could not be started; no restart was sent.
result_helper_import_failed: The bridge helper could not import its protected code; no restart was sent.
result_helper_exit_nonzero: The bridge helper exited without a confirmed result.
result_helper_timeout: The bridge helper timed out; a restart may still have taken effect.
result_helper_response_invalid: The bridge helper returned an invalid response; the outcome is unconfirmed.
result_manager_unreachable: The service manager was unavailable before dispatch; no restart was sent.
result_manager_response_invalid: The initial service state was invalid; no restart was sent.
result_restart_not_sent: The restart command could not be started; no restart was sent.
result_restart_rejected: The restart command returned an error; its effect is unconfirmed.
result_restart_timeout: The restart command timed out; its effect is unconfirmed.
result_restart_unconfirmed: The restart attempt could not be confirmed.
result_verification_failed: The service state could not confirm a stable restart.
result_invocation_unchanged: No new service invocation was observed.
result_restart_confirmed: A new active service invocation was observed.
result_backend_unhealthy: The backend did not remain stable and healthy.
result_handler_failed: The execution handler stopped without a confirmed result.
result_invalid_result: The execution result was invalid; check it from the administrator terminal.
result_operation_rejected: The operation was refused before execution.
result_interrupted: Execution was interrupted; its effect must be checked.
result_operator_reconciled_succeeded: The operator recorded a successful outcome without repeating the action.
result_operator_reconciled_failed: The operator recorded a failed outcome without repeating the action.
result_helper_io_failed: The bridge helper connection failed after launch; its effect is unconfirmed.
